title: cerastium alpinum var. lanatum
intro: Cerastium alpinum var. lanatum, commonly known as Alpine Mouse-ear or Woolly Mouse-ear, is a perennial herbaceous plant belonging to the family Caryophyllaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may aid in wound healing, reducing fever, and protecting against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Cerastium alpinum var. lanatum are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which may exert anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and antibacterial effects. However, more research is needed to fully understand the efficacy and safety of using this plant for medicinal purposes.
